zh: 设置页「对话」页新增「对话统计信息位置」：会话统计与 Token 用量此前只有一个去处——输入区上下文圆环的弹层。现在默认把它们写在输入卡片下面单独一行：轮数与步数、输出速度、读入与写回的 tokens、缓存命中率，末尾就是那个圆环，宿主统计行上的图标一个都不出现；也可以选「收进上下文」，回到弹层那一份。这一行里的数字一有变化就逐个字符重新入场（每走一个步骤、流式输出期间都在动，没变的数字保持不动），缓存命中率与圆环按各自的无极色阶取色（命中率九成的红到 99% 的深绿，占用两成的绿到四成的红，两个色标之间由浏览器在 OKLCH 里插值）。窗口窄到这一行放不下时它按固定顺序让位——先去缓存那截的字样，再去轮数与步数，再去圆环旁的数字（环留下），然后把读入与写回合成一个合计并去掉箭头，最后把数字折叠成 k / M / B——数字不再挤在一起互相压字，窗口宽回来时按同一顺序退回。这一项从此有自己的设置，不再与「重绘权限控件」共用一个开关；设置表单多了一个字段，正在运行的宿主重启一次才会提供它。
en: The settings page's Conversation tab gains Conversation statistics position: the session statistics and the token usage used to have one place to live — the popover of the composer's context ring. By default they now stand on a line of their own below the input card: the turns and steps, the output speed, the tokens read in and written back and the cache-hit share, with the ring itself at the end and none of the host row's icons; Inside the context popover is still available for the panel's own set. A figure on that line re-enters character by character whenever it moves (every step and all through a streaming answer, while the figures that did not move stay still), and the cache share and the ring each take their own colour band (the share from red in the nineties to dark green at 99%, the occupancy from green at a fifth to red at two fifths, mixed between stops by the browser in OKLCH). A window too narrow for the whole line makes it give way in a fixed order — first the cache share's words, then the turns and steps, then the number beside the ring (the ring stays), then the tokens read in and written back as one total without the arrows, and last the counts folded into k / M / B — so figures never crowd each other or draw over one another, and the same order gives them back as the window grows. The row answers to a setting of its own from now on rather than sharing the permission control's switch, and the settings form carries one more field, which a running host serves after a restart.
